length.text: Up to about 78 cm (one female 113 cm)

reproduction.text: Can lay eggs or give live birth

overview.text: The Brown-banded Water Snake is an aquatic snake of tropical South America and Trinidad and Tobago.

identification.text: Olive or grey-brown with dark brown, black-edged crossbands.

size.label: Adults
size.text: Up to about 78 cm, though one female of 113 cm has been reported.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: Venezuela, Colombia, the Guianas, Brazil, Ecuador, Peru, Bolivia and Trinidad.

diet.text: Mainly fish, and probably frogs, tadpoles and eggs.

reproduction.text: One of only a handful of snakes known to both lay eggs and give birth to live young.

funfacts.text: The same species can either lay eggs or give birth to live babies.

recognise.text: Banded water snake, usually seen in water.
